title: Specify bounded header acquisition recovery
description:
Specify acquisition and header-loss recovery independently from data/parity recovery. Cover missing, corrupt, repeated and conflicting headers, late join, interrupted blocks, expiry, abort and reacquisition. Account for every recovery emission and reserved receive opportunity.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Research contract only. Do not invent unauthenticated fragments to make acquisition cheap or displace existing control/RX commitments. No code, physical ports or RF operation is authorized by this document.
acceptance_criteria: Independent state traces establish bounded attempts, time, storage and recovery behavior. A missing initial header cannot be hidden inside the erasure-code success assumption. All metadata and identity bindings requiring authentication are explicitly listed for microfrag.06 review.
